# Android 1.0.20: Pair Device onboarding

A never-configured installation now offers a first-run Pair Device dialog explaining shared-network Backend enrollment for courts and stats. Pair Device opens the existing native QR scanner directly; Later dismisses the guidance. Paste Address provides a camera-free enrollment fallback; dismissing a scan failure clears the pending scan so retries remain available. The reminder is stored locally so normal refresh, navigation and subsequent launches do not repeatedly interrupt the user. Options > Pair Device remains available without entering locked Settings.

Enrollment still creates Companion access only. Control requires administrator eligibility and the individual Device PIN. Existing credentials and configured installations are untouched. The automatic prompt depends on absent configuration, not a failed connection or revoked session. Existing enrollment validation, single-use tickets, revocation and native lifecycle guards are unchanged.

Validation: all 53 preexisting non-browser scripts passed; new actual Options/native-bridge test passed; JavaScript syntax passed; native APK build passed with deprecation warnings; signature v2/v3 verified against original certificate; manifest com.cerberus.courtline, versionCode120, versionName1.0.20. Chromium UI regression could not launch because of container socket permissions, including after escalation. Native dialog/scanner and fresh/upgrade flows have NOT been physically tested.

Physical acceptance: fresh install shows guidance; Later closes it; Options > Pair Device opens scanner; cancel leaves Companion intact; scan PC Pair New Device QR enrolls as Companion and appears in Backend device list; Control still requires its device PIN. Existing paired install retains pairing with no fresh prompt, including offline restart; explicit revoked device cannot regain access without fresh enrollment.
